reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Ohio
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: "Are eviction cases first heard in high court?"
*/

/* -----------------------------
   Scenario facts (question context)
   ----------------------------- */

scenario_state(ohio).
scenario_year(2021).

/* We model the question as concerning an Ohio "eviction case", i.e., an action
   under Ohio Rev. Code Chapter 1923 (Forcible Entry and Detainer). */
scenario_case(case1).
scenario_case_type(case1, eviction_forcible_entry_and_detainer).

/* The factual statement being tested: "eviction cases [are] first heard in high court".
   We encode the *claim* as a query target rather than a fact, because we must derive
   yes/no from the statute. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(ohio),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_case(case1),
    scenario_case_type(case1, eviction_forcible_entry_and_detainer).

/* -----------------------------
   Statute translation: Ohio Rev Code  1923.01 (2021)
   ----------------------------- */

/* Effective date note (from provided text): Effective September 10, 2012.
   We treat the statute as applicable in any year >= 2012. */
statute_orc_1923_01_applicable(State, Year) :-
    State = ohio,
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2012.

/* ORC 1923.01(A) (2021):
   "any judge of a county or municipal court or a court of common pleas ... may inquire"
   -> authorized courts for initial inquiry/hearing in an action under this chapter. */
statute_orc_1923_01_authorized_court(State, Year, county_court) :-
    statute_orc_1923_01_applicable(State, Year).
statute_orc_1923_01_authorized_court(State, Year, municipal_court) :-
    statute_orc_1923_01_applicable(State, Year).
statute_orc_1923_01_authorized_court(State, Year, court_of_common_pleas) :-
    statute_orc_1923_01_applicable(State, Year).

/* ORC 1923.01(B) (2021): action must be brought within two years after accrual.
   Included for completeness; not needed to answer the court-level question. */
statute_orc_1923_01_limitations_period_years(ohio, 2) :-
    statute_orc_1923_01_applicable(ohio, 2012).

/* ORC 1923.01(A): if unlawful detainer found, judge shall cause restitution.
   Included for completeness; not needed to answer the "high court first heard" question. */
statute_orc_1923_01_restitution_required_if_unlawful_detainer_found(ohio, Year) :-
    statute_orc_1923_01_applicable(ohio, Year).

/* ORC 1923.01(C) definitions (abridged to deterministically capture definitional structure).
   Not required for the court forum question, but included to encode the statute's definitions. */
statute_orc_1923_01_definition(ohio, tenant, person_entitled_under_rental_agreement_to_occupy_premises_excluding_others_except_specific_manufactured_home_context).
statute_orc_1923_01_definition(ohio, landlord, owner_lessor_sublessor_or_authorized_agent_except_park_operator_if_required_by_facts).
statute_orc_1923_01_definition(ohio, rental_agreement, any_written_or_oral_agreement_establishing_terms_for_use_or_occupancy_with_specific_statutory_exceptions).
statute_orc_1923_01_definition(ohio, residential_premises, as_defined_in_5321_01_with_specific_manufactured_home_cross_reference).
statute_orc_1923_01_definition(ohio, manufactured_home_park, as_defined_in_4781_01_and_includes_tract_with_one_or_two_homes_under_rental_agreements).

/* -----------------------------
   Legal reasoning helpers
   ----------------------------- */

/* "High court" is not a term in ORC 1923.01. For purposes of answering the question,
   we model "high court" as the Court of Common Pleas (Ohio's general jurisdiction trial court). */
high_court(court_of_common_pleas).

/* An eviction (forcible entry and detainer) case in Ohio is an "action under this chapter"
   for ORC 1923.01(A) purposes. */
legal_action_under_orc_1923_chapter(eviction_forcible_entry_and_detainer).

/* Authorized court types for the scenario case, derived from ORC 1923.01(A). */
authorized_court_for_case(Case, CourtType) :-
    scenario_case(Case),
    scenario_case_type(Case, CaseType),
    legal_action_under_orc_1923_chapter(CaseType),
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    statute_orc_1923_01_authorized_court(State, Year, CourtType).

/* The question asks whether eviction cases are "first heard" in high court.
   We treat "first heard in high court" as "must be initially filed/heard only in high court."
   That would be true only if no non-high-court forum is authorized by statute. */
first_hearing_must_be_in_high_court(Case) :-
    authorized_court_for_case(Case, _), /* ensures the case is within the statute */
    \+ ( authorized_court_for_case(Case, CourtType),
         \+ high_court(CourtType)
       ).

/* -----------------------------
   Final answer
   ----------------------------- */

housing_answer(Result) :-
    scenario_statement,
    ( first_hearing_must_be_in_high_court(case1)
    -> Result = yes
    ;  Result = no
    ),
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Main entrypoint
   ----------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Are eviction cases first heard in high court?
